question: How often do the nested study's activity calls (full-series reference, three-point forecasts, and the calibrated release chain) agree with expert DNT reference labels that EPA ships with the same public NFA package?
decision: Whether the manuscript's limitation sentence 'the screening reference is an assay-derived activity label' (manuscript.md line 147) becomes a quantified result, and whether three-point reporting loses agreement with expert labels relative to the full series.
prior_exposure: Before this protocol, the panorama note (<local-input>/16ab6f73c309/prior_exploration.md section 3.8) recorded an unsaved exploratory look on all 96 labeled substances: full-series agreement 0.708, kappa 0.243; three-point baseline agreement 0.75; with the call encoding inverted, anchorboost 0.745, loglinear and measured_only 0.687. Those numbers were not saved and are not reused; this protocol fixes the rules before any saved computation.

upstream_verification.consequence: Appendix.A is a literature/regulatory curation with one assay-informed override (loperamide, a fold-1 primary substance). It is an external label, not a biological ground truth either; the three lists disagree among themselves.

upstream_context.use: copied as published context, not recomputed; unit is EPA sample id over their own chemical set

frozen_rules.join: Substance = key of identities.json (243). Label = row of the label file whose DTXSID equals identities[substance].dtxsid by exact string match. No salt/parent propagation: each substance keeps its own label or none. A DTXSID with two different labels in one file aborts the run.
frozen_rules.label_values: Case-folded first letter capitalized: Positive or Negative; anything else (blank, NA, 'na') = unlabeled and excluded from that label set.
frozen_rules.call_encoding: In design_decisions.csv every *_call and truth is 1 = inactive (endpoint below the training cutoff), 0 = active (paper_nested_decision.py protocol endpoint text and apply_rule: int(x <= cutoff)). Expert Positive is matched by active (0), Negative by inactive (1).

readouts.full_series: truth (full-series reference call; constant within substance)
readouts.forecast_<m>: <m>_call on every design, m in anchorboost, loglinear, measured_only (three-point call before any release decision)
readouts.chain_<m>: reported call of the deployed chain: <m>_call where <m>_release is True, else truth (the design falls back to the full series)

frozen_rules.folding: Primary: design-level scoring; every substance has exactly 5 designs, so each substance carries weight 1 and the 2x2 table counts designs/5 per substance. Secondary: per-substance majority over its 5 designs (>=3 inactive -> inactive). full_series is the same under both.
frozen_rules.metrics: sensitivity = share of Positive-substance designs called active; specificity = share of Negative-substance designs called inactive; balanced accuracy = mean of the two; agreement = share of all labeled designs matching; Cohen's kappa on the design-count 2x2 table.

sets.primary: outer folds 1-4, Appendix.A labeled substances (expected 55 Positive / 19 Negative = 74)
sets.sensitivity_all_folds: all five outer folds incl. development fold 0 (expected 72/24 = 96)
sets.sensitivity_no_override: primary set with loperamide set back to the original xlsx Negative

frozen_rules.intervals: Stratified drug-group bootstrap, 4000 replicates, numpy default_rng(20261006). Unit = drug_group from identities.json restricted to labeled substances. Strata in order Positive, Negative, mixed (a group whose labeled substances carry both labels); groups sorted by drug_group string within stratum; each replicate draws rng.integers(0, n_s, n_s) per stratum in that order and pools the selected groups' substances with multiplicity. 95% percentile interval via numpy.quantile default. Paired differences (readout minus full_series) use the same replicate draws. Negatives number 14-24 in every set: results quote intervals, never a lone point value, for specificity, balanced accuracy and kappa.
frozen_rules.table2_release: Released designs only (chain readouts): count released, count whose released call disagrees with the expert label, and the full-series disagreement on the same released designs; paired difference with the same bootstrap.
frozen_rules.table3_class: Class = 'Class' column of annotate_dnt_ref_chems.csv joined by DTXSID; 'Food Additive' and 'Food additive' merged by case-folding to 'Food additive'; missing -> 'Not annotated'; no other merging. Per class over folds 1-4 substances: substances, designs, Appendix.A Positive/Negative counts, anchorboost released wrong reports versus the full series (the paper's error definition), disagreements with Appendix.A for full_series and chain_anchorboost. Descriptive counts only, no intervals.
frozen_rules.context_row: Upstream's own NFA readouts versus the revised Mundy list (Results_sens_spec_BA_refine_ref2.csv): balanced accuracy range across their 12 readouts, quoted as published; different unit (sample id) and chemical set, so no paired comparison.

resource_limit: single process < 4 GB, seconds of CPU
